steps.description: Validate aggregate state, matcher handoff, SDK section tracker contract, IExecutionPlanStore signature, and section-result/query-result/finding-ref models
Create execution contract for the Query section tracker slice
Implement concrete SDK ISectionTracker in Shared Query Dataflow backed by IExecutionPlanStore polling and in-memory accumulation

Add focused section tracker tests for single-section success, multi-query section, empty queries, unit failure attribution, multi-unit-per-query coverage, idempotent emission, polling cadence, and cancellation
Run targeted Shared build and Query shared tests
Run task-orchestrator verifier and code-reviewer passes
Finalize task notes, aggregate state, and global archive

notes: Shared project build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
Query shared test project passed 105 tests (93 prior plus 12 new tracker tests).
Test command emitted NU1900 vulnerability-source warnings because external NuGet/CodeArtifact vulnerability indexes were unavailable.
Verifier PASS with one informational nit reconciled by updating decisions.md to describe the actual signal-channel mechanism instead of a literal output channel.

Minor findings Mi1 (linear unit-id scan) and Mi2 (single-consumer invariant comment) fixed; reverse index added and field comment added.
Nit N1 fixed via [NotNullWhen(true)] on TryBuildSectionResult; N2 declined (cold path).
Hygiene precondition: GlobalUsings.cs added to test project so it compiles after operator/linter trimmed per-file usings from QueryDistributorTests.cs and QueryMatcherTests.cs.
